Definition: Sabta or Sabtah, the name of a son of Cush, and the country occupied by his posterity
BiblicalUsage: Sabta was a son of Cush, named in the table of nations beside Seba, Havilah, Raamah and Sabtecha, and the name also stands for the country his posterity settled. He belongs to the first generations after the flood, when the nations were spreading out.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God knows the nations by name from the very beginning, and Sabta is one of the first names on that list.
